what: the observable universe in the same equatorial slice: SDSS quasars [RA deg, z] to z 7; the microwave background along the celestial equator (WMAP 9-yr ILC, microkelvin, one per degree of RA); horizons in billions of light-years (Planck 2018 cosmology, Davis & Lineweaver 2004)
beyond: the whole universe is at least ~250 times wider than the observable one if finite (Vardanyan, Trotta & Silk 2011)
credit: SDSS DR18 quasars · WMAP 9-year ILC map (NASA / LAMBDA) · Planck 2018 · Davis & Lineweaver 2004
